note: Source-isolated, label-free view of the full public Capture-24 release. The converter reads only time and raw accelerometer x/y/z from each participant file; activity annotations are never loaded, filtered, or used to define sessions. One participant stream may be split only at invalid timestamps or real clock discontinuities. Axivity AX3 dominant-wrist acceleration is 100 Hz, in g, with gravity present. Every emitted session carries only __unlabeled__ and is restricted to JEPA pretraining.
